hazards.description: Litter and uneven pavement surfaces create minor tripping hazards and indicate poor maintenance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked high-visibility crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near driveways and intersections to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees in the existing grass buffer to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and create a vertical sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repave the roadway and add clear lane markings to better organize traffic flow and improve the crossing environment.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and provide a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from parked and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Expand the existing sidewalk to a minimum of 5-6 feet to meet ADA standards and improve pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce street trees and a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical barrier and calm traffic.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces that can affect vehicle handling and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Install speed cushions or other vertical deflection measures to physically slow traffic to speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lanes and encourage slower driving speeds.
